title: Janax y Razar: un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador propios para un razonamiento artificial que piensa con melodías
description:
Janax is a hand-written operating system, language and assembler (all in assembly, no third-party engines) built to host Razar, an artificial reasoning system whose single judge is compression (two-part MDL). Version 0.8, Luma: one program and one window where what grows, what evolves and what lives share a world. (1) Gait: a period-finding instrument (the 'bat', a weighted-sinusoid listener with a shuffled null) hears the skeleton and the motion of 944 recordings of Gotching's creatures: rhythm in all real recordings and in none shuffled (pre-registered). Guessing the locomotion mode from all limbs pooled failed (22% vs 57% majority); Gotching's own geometric rule (what touches the floor is not a wing) lets the skeleton choose which group is heard: 60.4%, separating walk, crawl and fly. (2) Life: 236 creatures walk by their own gaits under local rules, approach when one piece of the other's gait would shorten their description, keep a shared piece only if it does, archive the rest with a reason, and relay what they learned. (3) Dialogues about imagined pieces: creatures dream variants and name them with melodies; all five pre-registered bets failed (the message acts as an event, not as meaning). (4) Luma: Razar's own forms, its meals of Gotching clouds and the creatures in one window; a cloud it eats is born as a creature. (5) Luma no longer needs Gotching's clouds: each creature is born with the body she remembers (median silhouette IoU 0.61); the release ships her fed home. (6) A common code from what she hears, sees, read and the code she read carries the exact piece in 100% of dialogues (0% shuffled) but is almost never kept (1 in 4,411). (7) Habitats from the gait alone: 55.5%, not above the 57.2% majority. Event-driven only: 0 CPU cycles when calm. OS test suite: 402 passed, 0 failed. Documentation is in Spanish.

Janax es un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador escritos a mano en assembler, hechos para alojar a Razar. v0.8: Luma — lo que crece, lo que evoluciona y lo que vive en una sola ventana, con las apuestas que fallaron publicadas. Prototipo de investigación.
